hints.title: Coverage Diameter
hints.text: A sensor with radius r covers a continuous segment of length 2 * r + 1 along each dimension.

hints.title: Axis Decomposition
hints.text: The minimal number of sensors along rows and columns can be computed independently using ceiling division.

hints.title: Total Sensor Count
hints.text: Multiply the number of sensors needed along the row dimension by those required along the column dimension.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minSensors(self, m: int, n: int, r: int) -> int:
        side = 2 * r + 1
        rows = (m + side - 1) // side
        cols = (n + side - 1) // side
        return rows * cols
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating sensor placement on the grid takes O(M * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluates the result instantaneously using constant arithmetic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derive the closed-form ceiling formula directly.
